name: French filter house
notes: A Juno chord loop through a slowly opening filter, with a phased supersaw lead and a rubbery bass.
code:
setcpm(124/4)

drums: s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.65).duckorbit(2).duckattack(0.2).duckdepth(0.8)
claps: s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.5)
hats: s("[~ hh]*4, [~ ~ oh ~]*2").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.3).hpf(7000)
chords: s("juno:4").struct("[x ~ x ~] [~ x ~ x] [x ~ x ~] [~ x x ~]").speed("<1 1 0.891 0.944>").lpf(sine.range(400, 5000).slow(32)).lpq(6).shape(0.2).gain(0.3).juxBy(0.6, x => x.late(0.012)).orbit(2)
lead: note("<a3 c4 e4 g4>*4").s("supersaw").unison(3).detune(0.1).decay(0.12).sustain(0).phaser(2).phaserdepth(0.6).lpf(2400).gain(0.35).delay(0.35).delaytime(0.36).delayfeedback(0.45).orbit(2)
bass: note("<a1 a1 f1 g1>").struct("[~ x]*4").s("sawtooth").lpf(300).lpenv(3).lpdecay(0.12).lpsustain(0).lpq(8).decay(0.2).sustain(0.3).shape(0.3).gain(0.55).orbit(2)
